citation: SantaLucia J Jr. A unified view of polymer, dumbbell, and oligonucleotide DNA nearest-neighbor thermodynamics
venue: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
what_it_anchors: The thermodynamic model behind every pairwise dG the package grades (criterion_spec ids hairpin_dg, cross_dimer_dg, homodimer_dg, pair:gate:gate_structure, *_structure gates)
claim: Nearest-neighbour stacking parameters give the melting temperature and the stability of a duplex, so a hairpin or dimer is graded by summed NN terms rather than by a base-pair count
access_detail: Not read directly: the citation is the one the Primer3 manual names as the source of its default melting-temperature method (PRIMER_TM_FORMULA=1, 'the table of thermodynamic values and the method for melting temperature calculation suggested in the paper [SantaLucia JR (1998) ... PNAS 95:1460-65 http://dx.doi.org/10.1073/pnas.95.4.1460]'), and Untergasser 2012 (PMC3424584) names it as reference 19 for Primer3's updated models. DOI and pages from the manual text and the reference list of PMC3424584, not from the paper's own page. It does NOT state the package's dG bars (-3 hairpin, -9 dimer): those stay package assumptions.
